name: Code review & quality
description: Automated review, static-analysis-style checks, and quality gates applied to code before or during merge.

name: Codebase migration & modernization
description: Large-scale refactors, framework upgrades, and legacy-to-modern migrations driven semi-autonomously.

name: Developer pair programming
description: In-IDE, real-time coding assistance: autocomplete, inline edits, and chat-driven changes as a developer works.

name: Autonomous end-to-end engineering
description: Given a ticket or goal, an agent plans, writes, tests, and iterates on code with minimal supervision.

name: Desktop & legacy UI automation
description: Agents that operate a screen (mouse/keyboard/screenshots) to automate systems that expose no API.

name: Autonomous web task completion
description: Agents that browse the live web to complete multi-step tasks -- bookings, forms, comparisons, purchases -- on a user's behalf.

name: Web & competitive research
description: Cited, multi-source research and research-brief generation: market, competitor, academic, or regulatory.

name: Enterprise RAG & knowledge management
description: Retrieval-augmented generation and search over an organization's own documents and internal tools.

name: Multi-agent orchestration & observability
description: Frameworks and tooling for coordinating multiple specialized agents and tracing/debugging their runs in production.

name: Customer support automation
description: Agents that triage, resolve, or draft responses to customer support requests, with or without human handoff.

name: Sales, marketing & content generation
description: Drafting marketing copy, sales content, research briefs, or product listings via an agent pipeline.

name: Compliance & regulatory documentation
description: Drafting, cross-checking, or researching documents against regulatory, safety, or contractual requirements.

name: Industrial operations & predictive maintenance
description: Agents monitoring plant, vehicle, or warehouse telemetry to triage alerts, inspect quality, or flag maintenance needs.

name: Procurement & vendor operations
description: Sourcing, RFQ comparison, booking, and negotiation-prep tasks across supplier and vendor portals.

name: HR & workforce operations
description: Screening, onboarding, scheduling, and policy Q&A automation for HR and frontline-staffing teams.
